name.value: Garden Bay RV Resort | Park & Campground

description.value: A privately operated RV resort and campground on a 12-acre multi-level property near Pender Harbour on the Sunshine Coast, with tent sites alongside serviced RV pitches; access requires a BC Ferries crossing from West Vancouver and a paved drive north on Highway 101.

raw_osm.name: Garden Bay RV Resort | Park & Campground

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a year-round RV park and campground on BC's Sunshine Coast (Pender Harbour area) with 51 sites, opened end of 2020. Tent sites are explicitly available ('No Service Sites & Tent Sites Also Available'). Amenities confirmed from the website include hot showers, laundry, covered BBQ gazebos, shaded pavilions, and water. The about page confirms proximity to stores and restaurants. Reservations are confirmed via the prominent 'BOOK NOW' button. No cycling-specific amenities (hiker/biker sites, cyclist discount, bike tools, pump) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Phone number inconsistency on website itself: main pages show 604-989-7624 while 'handy info' and 'BC road trips' subpages show 604-393-3823
OSM community classification says 'Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but this is on the Sunshine Coast (Pender Harbour area, north of Sechelt and Gibsons)
Outdated COVID-19 page still present restricting to BC residents with self-contained RVs only — likely no longer in effect
OSM name uses pipe character ('|') while website uses comma and ampersand ('Garden Bay RV Resort, Park & Campground')
Primarily RV-oriented resort; tent sites are secondary and no cycling-specific services are mentioned
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Year-round campground with tent sites, showers, laundry, water, and covered shelters on the Sunshine Coast — a popular BC cycling corridor accessible by ferry. Suitable for touring cyclists despite being RV-focused.

wow_evidence: hot showers, laundry, covered BBQ gazebos, shaded pavilions, and water
